metadata.dataset_name: Saraswati Heights: five-month synthetic operating history
metadata.data_classification: ENTIRELY SYNTHETIC — fictional school, students, staff, fees, incidents and measurements
metadata.reproducibility: Regenerate using this script's fixed seed and rules; a production engine should persist PRNG state and code version at checkpoints.
metadata.scope: Five calendar months (151 days), 1,000 opening students, 123 payroll staff plus a contractor-run canteen, 18 planted evaluation events, five assessment windows and daily financial/camera/feedback traces.
metadata.non_source_disclaimer: Public sources provide record categories, policy context and broad structural benchmarks only. No private school management database, CCTV footage, real student/staff record, real Delhi school fee schedule or real salary data was accessed.
metadata.privacy: No faces, recordings, phone numbers, full addresses, biometrics or student identity inference. CCTV records are synthetic zone counts only; person-level fictional observation notes come from classroom/admin sources and must not be inferred from CCTV.
metadata.accounting: INR amounts are illustrative model assumptions. Expense accruals and cash disbursements are separate; fee collection targets model payment behaviour, not observed collection rates. No actual GST/tax, debt service, depreciation, capital expenditure, grants or full statutory accounting is represented.
metadata.legal_caution: This is a software demo, not compliance advice. Fee change workflows refer to official Delhi Act/Rules for context, but actual commencement, applicability, orders and a school's approved fee structure require current legal review.

public_baseline_methodology.approach: Reviewed public UDISE+ state aggregates, CBSE infrastructure/affiliation requirements and public school-ERP module descriptions; used them to design plausible fields, not to scrape private student records.

staffing_context.interpretation: A simple schoolwide headcount ratio. Do not compare it directly to UDISE stage-specific PTR without aligning stage definitions and teacher counting conventions.

public_baseline_methodology.class_size_context: Opening section assignments follow the grade totals in enrollment_plan and keep 36 sections below 40 students. April promotions are logged separately so historical grades stay interpretable.
public_baseline_methodology.fee_context: Monthly fee-plan amounts, concessions and transport charges are synthetic assumptions for stress-testing. They are not a recommendation or evidence of fees charged by a Delhi school.

sources.title: UDISE+ Report 2023–24, Table 4.12 (PTR by NEP stage)
sources.used_for: Broad Delhi stage-level pupil-teacher ratio context only; Delhi table lists 15 foundational, 19 preparatory, 28 middle and 20 secondary. These are population-level aggregates, not this fictional school's staffing prescription.

sources.title: CBSE Infrastructure and Affiliation Requirements
sources.used_for: Section sizes (CBSE says optimum 40 students per section), room/facility plausibility and campus record categories.

sources.title: CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws
sources.used_for: School governance and roles such as counsellor/wellness teacher, special educator, medical records and documented operations; real compliance needs a clause-by-clause review.

sources.title: Delhi School Education (Transparency in Fixation and Regulation of Fees) Act, 2025
sources.used_for: Motivates itemised fee heads, audit trail, no invented fee hike in the story, and a governance review before any change. Legal applicability/commencement must be checked for an actual institution.

sources.title: Delhi School Education (Transparency in Fixation and Regulation of Fees) Rules, 2025
sources.used_for: Fee transparency workflows and approvals; the synthetic fee amount is not a claim about legal fees or any real school.

sources.title: Drishti Innovations School ERP Modules
sources.used_for: Operational record types: admissions, attendance, fees, timetables, examinations, transport, library, inventory, HR and MIS reports.

sources.title: School ERP module landscape (admissions, fees, attendance, exams, transport, payroll)
sources.used_for: Cross-checks the operational module categories used in the JSON; a vendor feature list is not a source for this school's invented numbers.

school_configuration.name: Saraswati Heights Senior Secondary School
school_configuration.data_label: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO DATA — not a real school or real student records

location.address: Fictional campus; no real street address
location.board_archetype: CBSE-style senior secondary school; affiliation is a scenario assumption
location.campus_profile: multi-storey urban campus, courtyard, library, labs, canteen, playground and bus bay

period.calendar_status: synthetic scenario calendar; not an official Delhi school calendar

calendar_policy.regular_days: Monday-Friday, plus first and third Saturdays for limited remedial/admin work; Sundays closed
calendar_policy.note: Dates intentionally make a repeatable story. Verify an actual school calendar separately.

fees.concessions: explicit synthetic credits against a fee plan; not a real scholarship register
fees.policy: No unapproved increase is collected in the story. A real Delhi fee schedule must be checked against current GNCTD law, rules, orders and school disclosures.

students.name: Aarav Malhotra
students.arc: Starts by reporting problems formally; learns leadership requires listening to students who score less well.

students.name: Sana Khan
students.arc: Challenges an unannounced worksheet; the disagreement evolves into clearer assessment expectations, not a punishment-only story.

students.name: Kabir Saini
students.arc: A practical joker sometimes causes real disruption; a supervised robotics task helps, but does not make him perfect.

students.name: Mehak Bansal
students.arc: Performs consistently but needs low-key support to ask questions before exams.

students.name: Dev Arora
students.arc: Gets a fair conduct response for unapproved sales, then helps measure canteen queues.

students.name: Nidhi Rao
students.arc: Reports exclusion from a science group; teacher notes show aggregate grades missed the social issue.

students.name: Arjun Yadav
students.arc: A minor corridor bump helps trigger a one-way-flow trial and better adult duty positions.

students.name: Tara George
students.arc: Flags an inventory discrepancy; paperwork, not a simplistic theft story, explains most of it.

students.name: Zoya Parveen
students.arc: Oral checks and art make her strengths visible beyond written-score averages.

students.name: Rishabh Dahiya
students.arc: A marks correction teaches him how to challenge grades with evidence rather than accusation.

students.name: Ishita Verma
students.arc: Feedback reveals reliable students are often overloaded with unpaid classroom responsibilities.

students.name: Farhan Qureshi
students.arc: Attendance falls during exam season; a timetable conversation helps, but performance remains uneven.

students.name: Pihu Chawla
students.arc: A helper role and line-management reminders reduce repeated lunch-line friction.

students.name: Aditi Tomar
students.arc: Pushes for fee-head clarity while acknowledging she cannot speak for every family.

students.name: Yash Bedi
students.arc: Joins Kabir's hallway joke, then helps with a safer-corridor campaign after restorative follow-up.

students.name: Simran Gill
students.arc: Her clear account explains a canteen pushing incident that aggregate sensors could flag but not interpret.

students.name: Manav Sehgal
students.arc: Helps document a lab power issue but is not permitted to touch mains electrical equipment.

students.name: Kritika Solanki
students.arc: Repeats a fee-hike rumour and later helps correct it when verified information is published.

students.name: Om Prakash
frictions: written work slower than oral understanding
students.arc: Oral checks show a more balanced picture of his understanding without inflating grades.

students.name: Rhea Anand
frictions: waits for invitation before correcting a record
students.arc: Works with Aditi on clear, non-accusatory questions for the fee transparency meeting.

students.name: Gurleen Kaur
students.arc: A gate handover near-miss improves the authorised-pickup checklist; the child is not blamed for a process failure.

students.name: Neil Joseph
students.arc: A teacher switches to a private check-in; disruption falls but does not disappear.

students.name: Sakshi Rawat
frictions: equates a low score with personal failure
students.arc: Exam pressure causes a short attendance dip; staff offer workload guidance rather than blanket punishment.

students.name: Adil Ansari
students.arc: Questions canteen queue privileges and becomes part of a student-led queue audit.

character_profiles.note: 24 named protagonists have longer narrative arcs; all are fictional. Their traits are tendencies, not deterministic rules. Generic students are also assigned variable strengths, frictions and attendance propensities.

2026-02.managerial_note: A month can show an operating surplus and still have timing pressure on cash due to payroll and supplier payments.

accounting_controls: Receipts for current month are separate from recovery of prior accounts receivable.
Monthly invoices are posted on each month's first calendar day, even during synthetic school closure.
Cash payroll is a monthly payment while payroll expense accrues daily.
The May 12 fuel invoice is modelled at ₹45,360 vs ₹42,000 reference; only ₹42,000 is paid and ₹3,360 is held pending evidence.
The May 25 water motor repair and emergency tanker total ₹30,500 in cash payments and are separate payment records.
known_model_limits: No complete double-entry chart of accounts; expenses and payments can represent different invoice vintages.
No taxation, depreciation, debt, detailed payables ageing, refunds, GST treatment or real fee-law certification.
Cash balance is an illustrative liquidity trace; do not use for any real budget decision.

detector.name: SchoolTwin rule-based anomaly detector v1

detector_input_contract.allowed: daily aggregate attendance/absence/late-arrival metrics, class/teacher feedback counts, aggregate CCTV zone counts, finance totals and numeric work-order/ERP counters
detector_input_contract.blocked: daily_story, named character observations, incident explanations, principal narratives, ground_truth_events_hidden_from_detector and evaluation labels
detector_input_contract.camera_limit: A count can flag a deviation but cannot identify a person, prove intent, diagnose a medical condition or explain a cause.

detector.rules_note: Thresholds are hand-authored for the demonstration and must be tuned on real, privacy-safe, labelled synthetic runs before use in any experiment.

alerts.model_note: Rule-based synthetic demonstration; scores are not trained, calibrated or suitable for real-school decisions.

evaluation.false_positive_policy: The initial baseline is deliberately conservative and does not claim calibrated precision. Operators must review every alert and should not automate punishment, fee changes or safety decisions.

ground_truth_events_hidden_from_detector.purpose: Evaluation-only causal labels and intended resolutions. In a real codebase this object should be stored in a separate evaluator file/service and never passed into the detector prompt or runtime state.

events.hidden_cause: cold morning, dense fog on two feeder roads and family discretion
expected_signals: attendance down more than normal weekday variation
events.impact: attendance 6–9 percentage points below nearby Fridays; three routes report delays
events.resolution: late arrivals counted accurately; no blanket penalty; parents receive route-specific update

events.hidden_cause: unannounced worksheet given after students understood the week to be revision-only
expected_signals: teacher feedback shows a policy disagreement
events.impact: one lesson loses 9 minutes; six students file a joint concern; no physical aggression
events.resolution: teacher explains the learning goal, records future assessment notice, and allows a rubric-based review

events.hidden_cause: three kits moved to an adjacent room for demonstration; return register was not signed; two pieces still awaiting reconciliation
expected_signals: science store access outside expected pattern
events.impact: lab practical for one class starts 12 minutes late; no evidence establishes theft
events.resolution: pause nonessential issue-out, count with two staff, document location and replacement cost only if genuinely missing

events.hidden_cause: student felt light-headed after skipping breakfast; cause is reported, not medically confirmed
expected_signals: one class exit count briefly changes
events.impact: student rests under nurse supervision; guardian collects after a phone call; no diagnosis inferred
events.resolution: first-aid log and guardian handover completed; school sends general wellbeing reminder

events.hidden_cause: one driver calls in sick before dispatch and the first backup is already assigned to a vehicle inspection
expected_signals: first-period attendance dip concentrated in bus riders
events.impact: 114 students arrive 8–24 minutes late; no crash; two first periods use recap work
events.resolution: notify families, log duty hours, do not mark bus-related late students absent for the whole day

events.hidden_cause: annual-day rehearsals and parent check-in converge at one corridor junction
expected_signals: two adults report poor sign visibility
events.impact: peak aggregate queue estimate 76 people and 11-minute wait; one pushing complaint, no serious injury
events.resolution: separate parent and student lines, add marshal, move drinking-water table away from turn

events.hidden_cause: bulk reminder template sent twice after two filtered recipient exports overlapped
expected_signals: finance log has duplicate notice batch ID
events.impact: 27 families get duplicate reminder messages; no duplicate receipt or second debit is recorded
events.resolution: send correction and add second-person batch approval before bulk messaging

events.hidden_cause: Ananya Malik has a three-day illness-related absence; prefilled cover plan contains two clashes
expected_signals: cover periods displace library and remedial blocks
events.impact: five cover periods lack a subject specialist; two tasks are moved by a day
events.resolution: publish corrected cover plan, keep health information private, flag understaffed lessons rather than blame teacher

events.hidden_cause: last three pages of one exam variant are missing in 24 packets
expected_signals: invigilator incident logs cluster by room
events.impact: 24 students start an incomplete paper; examination stops for the affected room and 15 minutes is added after corrected pages arrive
events.resolution: collect faulty packets, issue corrected pages, time-stamp all action, moderate affected question if needed

events.hidden_cause: an import sheet points at the wrong column for 18 records; discrepancy discovered before report cards are released
expected_signals: unusually narrow score shift in one subject
IT and exam cell tickets co-occur
events.impact: result release held for 1 day; no incorrect mark sheet is published
events.resolution: restore signed values, compare row counts and totals, keep audit trail, add dry-run validation

events.hidden_cause: two aging ceiling fans in Room 8B fail during a warm afternoon
expected_signals: student feedback mentions heat and concentration
events.impact: class changes room after 18 minutes; 32 students affected
events.resolution: isolate failed units, move class, qualified technician inspects wiring and bearings

events.hidden_cause: bus driver takes a tight turn around a delivery vehicle near the gate pillar
expected_signals: security and transport reports cross-reference same time
events.impact: minor scrape to pillar and bus side panel; no injuries; route delayed 16 minutes
events.resolution: incident report, vehicle check, review turning geometry and delivery window; no automatic assignment of fault to student

events.hidden_cause: Ritu Kapoor gives four-week notice after repeated unplanned cover and committee duties
expected_signals: teacher pulse feedback reports unsustainable workload
events.impact: short-term morale strain in Social Science team and need for handover plan
events.resolution: acknowledge notice, conduct a workload review and prepare a replacement; do not coerce employee to stay

events.hidden_cause: parents and students request an itemised explanation of fee heads after a rumour of an increase
expected_signals: admin lobby counts and parent queries rise
events.impact: 42 family queries over two days; no new fee is charged in response to the rumour
events.resolution: publish the approved schedule and itemisation after legal/accounting review; refer to current Delhi rules

events.hidden_cause: an early hot spell raises cooling demand and some families keep younger children home
expected_signals: electricity use above April daily average
events.impact: attendance about 5 percentage points lower than recent Tuesday average; utility accrual rises
events.resolution: water breaks, shade and room rotation; avoid unsafe heat exposure; report utility spike separately

events.hidden_cause: computer lab circuit trips under load; cause remains under qualified electrician review
events.impact: one lab session cancelled; 28 students moved to supervised paper-based exercise; no injury or confirmed equipment damage
events.resolution: keep lab closed until qualified electrician certifies circuit and load distribution

events.hidden_cause: fuel vendor invoice is 8% higher than previous written quote; changed quantities and taxes require reconciliation
events.impact: ₹45,360 billed vs ₹42,000 prior quote, before reconciliation; disputed increment ₹3,360 held
events.resolution: pay undisputed ₹42,000, request corrected invoice/supporting explanation, never label fraud without evidence

events.hidden_cause: campus water motor fails during student-free maintenance period
events.impact: ₹18,500 repair parts/labour and ₹12,000 emergency tanker; drinking-water checks are documented before normal use
events.resolution: record repair sign-off and tanker receipts; set preventive maintenance due date before reopening

decision_log.title: Issue route-specific attendance update
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Weather and late-arrival pattern suggest transport disruption rather than widespread disengagement.
decision_log.action: notify affected families and accept late arrival logs; do not punish all late students

decision_log.title: Run a restorative assessment-expectations discussion
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Class 8B students dispute an unannounced worksheet; source is unclear until teacher and student accounts are compared.
decision_log.action: publish the assessment notice rule and allow rubric-based review

decision_log.title: Freeze nonessential lab-kit issue-out for a recount
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Inventory discrepancy is a control gap; current evidence does not establish theft.
decision_log.action: two-person count and temporary checkout controls

decision_log.title: Use backup route coverage and family notification
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Late arrivals correlate with route merge after driver absence.
decision_log.action: retain passenger safety checks, notify families, log driver duty hours

decision_log.title: Correct duplicate reminders and add release approval
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Message batch overlap generated 27 queries but no duplicate payment.
decision_log.action: send correction; require a second reviewer for bulk send

decision_log.title: Replan subject cover for three days
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Teacher absence and clashes are creating weak subject coverage.
decision_log.action: move two low-stakes tasks, protect exam classes, keep medical details private

decision_log.title: Pause exam clock for affected room and extend time
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Incomplete printed pages compromise equal conditions.
decision_log.action: issue corrected pages with a 15-minute extension and incident audit

decision_log.title: Hold report-card publication until mark reconciliation
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Import anomaly affects 18 marks and can be corrected from signed records.
decision_log.action: restore source values and independently validate totals

decision_log.title: Move Class 8B and authorise technician inspection
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Room conditions affect concentration and two fans fail.
decision_log.action: do not energise units until technician clears them

decision_log.title: Run bus-safety review and delivery-window restriction
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Low-speed scrape, route delay and gate flow indicate a process weakness.
decision_log.action: inspect vehicle and revise gate turn procedure

decision_log.title: Open recruitment and protected handover plan
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Notice is a staff-retention signal; teacher is not at fault for systemic cover pressure.
decision_log.action: reassign work transparently and hire replacement

decision_log.title: Publish itemised approved fee-head explanation
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Questions are valid governance requests and the rumour is not evidence of an approved fee change.
decision_log.action: refer to GNCTD rules and accounts review; no new rate without due process

decision_log.title: Activate heat and hydration protocol
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Attendance, electricity and water-refill demand move together.
decision_log.action: water breaks, safe room rotation and monitor high-load areas

decision_log.title: Close computer lab until electrical safety sign-off
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Circuit trip under load has unknown root cause.

decision_log.title: Pay only undisputed portion of fuel invoice
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Price variance requires a reconciliation, not a fraud conclusion.

decision_log.title: Approve emergency water-motor repair with receipts
decision_log.reasoning_summary: No students are on campus but water supply must be restored and validated.
decision_log.action: require part receipt, electrician/plumber sign-off and water check

decision_log.title: Save baseline checkpoint and preserve unresolved issues
decision_log.reasoning_summary: Five-month record is complete enough for a controlled forward scenario.
decision_log.action: freeze immutable baseline; forks inherit only from this checkpoint unless user selects another

policy.engine_owns: attendance generation, state transitions, finance arithmetic, staffing availability, constraints and saved checkpoints
policy.llm_owns: optional judgement proposals, plain-language explanations and summaries; it does not mutate account balances or underlying state directly
human_approval_required_for: student safety/medical action beyond approved protocols
policy.fallback: When the LLM is unavailable, rules and prewritten narratives keep the simulation runnable.

state_includes: active student roster and fee/transport assignments
unresolved_items: fuel invoice increment ₹3,360 pending vendor reconciliation
water-motor repair requires receipt and preventive-maintenance date
computer lab remains closed until electrical safety sign-off is filed
Room 8B fan replacements must be checked before reopening
Social Science replacement recruitment and handover plan open
fee-head disclosure follow-up needs final governance sign-off
attendance follow-up remains open for students with recurrent absence
checkpoints.fork_policy: Clone this entire checkpoint immutably; apply only a user-specified configuration delta and a new branch seed. Preserve parent_checkpoint_id and branch_id; never overwrite the baseline.

scenario_levers.simulation_effect: adds monthly salary cost and reduces uncovered lessons probabilistically
changes new invoices only after governance approval gate; default disabled until approval
changes transport invoices after approval; may affect renewal/uptake assumptions
models transport follow-up, family communication and counselling capacity, not guaranteed attendance gains
reduces specified maintenance backlog if completed and verified
changes what AI proposals can apply; high-impact actions remain approval-gated

checkpoints_and_forking.monte_carlo_policy: Run scenario replicates from the same checkpoint with multiple branch seeds; report median, 10th–90th percentile, best/worst and the input assumptions. Never label this as a real-school forecast.

summary_metrics.detector_caveat: A demonstration metric on synthetic, deliberately designed events; not evidence of performance on real schools or unseen incidents.
